parent_objective: audit M2422 source-linked repair-candidate materialization and choose one bounded next route
blocked_by: M2422 materializes candidate overlays but does not audit whether they are reset/load-validation ready
candidate overlays must preserve collision, R4, max-step, speed-too-low, diagnostic, and family metadata
the next route must not jump directly to repair execution or measured rollout
supersedes: direct repair execution from M2422 overlays without audit
source-linked family/profile ranking from diagnostic rows
candidate winner selection from artifact-only overlays

public_gates: M2423 must audit M2422 candidate completeness, run-dir-only boundary, and guardrail metadata preservation
M2423 must decide whether to admit read-only reset/load validation adapter implementation, pivot to artifact repair, pivot to scenario-quality reassessment, or stop
M2423 must keep diagnostic and family-membership rows non-ranking

M2423 must not run rollout, execute repair, train, replay, run PPO, rank candidates/families/profiles, select a winner, overwrite active configs, or make scenario-redesign/training-repair/paper/current-sim/self-ID verdict claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rerun M2413 M2415 M2417 M2420 M2421 or M2422
do not reset/load validate in M2423
do not inject hidden or oracle features
do not rank support policies or controller families
do not overwrite the active scenario config
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits whether M2422 candidate overlays are complete enough for a bounded read-only reset/load validation adapter
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no reset/load execution, repair execution, training, rerun, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if M2422 candidate overlays are incomplete or not run-dir-only
stop if guardrail metadata is missing or diagnostic rows become repair/ranking rows
stop if next route would require source-linked family/profile/candidate ranking
stop if next route would require actor input contract changes or hidden/oracle features
stop if the only admissible route is scenario semantics rather than read-only adapter validation
fallback_plan: admit read-only reset/load validation adapter implementation only if candidate completeness and guardrails pass
pivot to artifact repair if M2422 schema or metadata is incomplete
pivot to scenario-quality reassessment if materialization is mostly task semantics
stop for user review if no bounded non-ranking route is supported
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2422 materialized run-dir-only source-linked repair candidate overlays

admission_evidence: M2422 active_config_overwrite_count repair_execution_allowed_count training_allowed_count ranking_admissible_count winner_selected_count and guardrail_violation_count are 0
allowed_updates: M2423 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit or branch stop
next_stage_criteria: M2422 candidate completeness is accepted or rejected
run-dir-only boundary is accepted or rejected
guardrail metadata preservation is accepted or rejected
one bounded next route is selected or the branch is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2423 audits candidate materialization and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2423; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If M2422 only supports scenario-quality changes, pivot instead of calling it driver repair.
allowed_claims: M2422 source-linked repair-candidate materialization completeness accepted or rejected

no controller ranking, source-linked family ranking, candidate ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits whether M2422 converted repair-plan rows into reset/load-validation-admissible candidate overlays
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit a bounded read-only adapter route but cannot establish current-sim or paper verdict

M2423 attempts to rank candidates, source-linked families, or profiles

hypothesis: The M2422 source-linked repair-candidate artifact can be audited into a read-only reset/load-validation route, artifact-repair route, scenario-quality pivot, or stop decision without executing repair, training, ranking, or verdict claims.
success_criteria: M2422 completeness, run-dir-only boundary, and guardrail metadata preservation are accepted or rejected with explicit counts
diagnostic and family-membership rows remain non-ranking

M2423 treats candidate materialization as repair or scenario redesign success
M2423 makes paper finite-window-vs-GRU current-sim verdict or level3 self-ID claims
